q: Is a CBAM fertiliser figure given per tonne of product or per tonne of nitrogen?
title: CBAM fertiliser figure: product or nitrogen
short: Per tonne of the good as imported, such as a tonne of urea or of NPK. The nitrogen content and the form it is in are reported as extra parameters, so the importer can compare products. Check the current implementing rules for the exact fields.
audience: Fertiliser producers and EU importers filling in CBAM data

p: Embedded emissions are stated per tonne of the good, the same unit as the customs declaration.

ul: Nitrogen content and the form: urea, nitrate or ammonium.
Phosphorus and potassium content for mixed fertilisers.

p: For NPK, the nitrogen compounds carry most of the emissions; precursors are attributed by their share.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and production documents into dated, fingerprinted installation records, the starting point for the actual emissions an EU importer asks for.

sources.label: European Commission, CBAM legislation and guidance
